visualCharacteristics.purpose: Slider of items with an optional heading row; the Style option picks the treatment
visualCharacteristics.description: instruments: dark stage with overlay panel and thumbnail rail flanked by prev/next arrows. split: single item as image beside a text panel with specs. resources: row of filter pills built from the authored filter labels, 3-up card slider (optional background image, category eyebrow, title, CTA button; cards without an image get a solid colour per category: Application #128bb2, Data Sheet #00927c, Brochures #006298 alternating #00a9e0, Videos #811167, Blogs/Articles/Symposiums/News Releases/Evidence each mapped, neutral navy default), dot pagination; clicking a pill filters cards by category, clicking it again clears. products: related-product card slider, 4 cards visible on desktop (3 / 2 / 1 on smaller screens), white shadowed cards with the image on top (linked to the card CTA), title, description clamped to 3 lines and a 'Learn more' text link; dot pagination below (hidden when every card fits in view), no arrows. gallery: product hero, contained two columns: a ~563x480 main stage with an 80x49 thumbnail strip below (thumbnails select the slide; video thumbnails get a play glyph, active thumbnail highlighted) on the left, the product text panel (H1, intro, variant, availability notice, CTA, in-page jump-link strip) on the right; stacks on mobile. Slides whose text holds a play.vidyard.com link show a poster with a play overlay and swap in the inline player on click. testimonials: one slide at a time in a light grey #efefef card: bold name and italic role above the quote, a red opening quote mark, optional cover image (beside the text on desktop) and CTA; prev/next chevron arrows at the sides and dot pagination below (active dot brand red); no autoplay; aria-roledescription carousel/slide, labelled buttons, arrow-key navigation.

contentPattern.structure: row 0 = heading/config (rich text; resources: a bulleted list of filter labels, plus optional heading); rows 1..N = one slide each: image cell (resources: may be left empty for a solid category colour) + rich text cell (resources: first paragraph = category matching a filter label, heading = title, trailing link paragraph = CTA); products: row 0 may be left empty, each slide = image + rich text (heading = title, paragraph = description, trailing link paragraph = 'Learn more' CTA); gallery: row 0 = product text panel (rich text: H1, paragraphs, CTA link, optional bulleted list of #anchor jump links), each slide = image (poster for videos; Vidyard poster used when empty) + rich text (optional play.vidyard.com link = video slide, link text = video title); testimonials: optional single-cell heading row (may be empty), each slide = optional image + rich text (leading bold-only paragraph = name, following italic-only paragraph = role, trailing link-only paragraph = CTA, the rest = quote)

usage.description: Home and About Us pages (instruments, split); Host Response to Infection and Remote Services Educational Resources sections (resources); REMISOL Advance related products (products); DxA 5000 Fit product hero (gallery) and related products (products).

reuseGuidance: Use resources for filterable resource/news card sliders. Use products for a paged row of related-product cards (image, title, description, Learn more). Use cards-grid for static grids that need no paging or filtering. Use gallery for a product hero with several images/videos and a product text panel; use hero (split-left) when there is a single static image.
